text:
London gets much more rain than dry cities such as Los Angeles (about 370 mm a year), Madrid (about 440 mm), Phoenix (about 200 mm), and Las Vegas (about 120 mm), compared with roughly 600 mm in London. It does not get much more than New York City, Chicago, or Paris, which get about as much or more. These are approximate long-term averages from memory, not checked against a live source.
